KANPRPLA.NS.d: Kanpur Plastipack Limited manufactures and exports flexible intermediate bulk containers (FIBC) worldwide. It also provides small polypropylene (PP)/HDPE woven sacks and bags, including laminated and unlaminated, printed and unprinted, box bags and bale wraps, pallet covers, food grain bags, fertilizer bags, and cement bags, as well as liner and gusseted bags, valve bags, and bale wraps.

KINGFA.NS.d: Kingfa Science & Technology (India) Limited manufactures and supplies reinforced polypropylene compounds and fiber reinforced composites in India. It also offers thermoplastic elastomers under the HYPRENE brand name; POM; fiberglass honeycomb composite panels; LFT products; and high temperature resistant nylon/LCP. The company supplies its products to automobile, electronic appliances, industrial equipment, consumer goods, packaging, toys, etc.

LAOPALA.NS.d: La Opala RG Limited manufactures and markets glass and glassware products in India and internationally. Its opal glass tableware products include plates, bowls, dinner sets, cup-saucer sets, coffee mugs and cups, tea and soup sets, and pudding and dessert sets; and crystalware products comprise barware, vases, bowls, and stemware. The company offers its products under the La Opala, Diva, and Solitaire brands. La Opala RG Limited was founded in 1987 and is based in Kolkata, India.

LGBBROSLTD.NS.d: L.G. Balakrishnan & Bros Limited manufactures and sells chains, sprockets, and metal formed parts for automotive applications in India and internationally. It operates through Transmission, Metal Forming, and Others segments. The company offers transmission products comprising motorcycle and moped drive chains, timing chains/engine mechanism chains, and automotive kits; sprockets; tensioners; belts; and brake shoes.

LIBAS.NS.d: Libas Consumer Products Limited engages in the process of fabrication of fabric into garments and other products in India. The company offers fabrics, sherwanis, kurtis, shoes, and other related items, as well as various men and women accessories, curtains, etc. It markets its products under the LIBAS RIYAZ GANGJI and LIBAS reshma riyaz gangji brands. The company offers its products through its retail stores, Shoppers Shop, online retailers, and its website.

MADRASFERT.NS.d: Madras Fertilizers Limited manufactures and sells fertilizers in India. It operates in two segments, Fertilizers and Other Activities. The company offers ammonia, urea, and complex fertilizers; biofertilizers; organic fertilizers; and agrochemicals under the VIJAY brand name.

NATCO-RE.NS.d: Natco Pharma Limited-RE is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker NATCO-RE and traded in INR. Its country is India.

NDL.NS.d: Nandan Denim Limited manufactures and sells denims, denim and shirting fabrics, cotton fabrics, and yarns in India. It also exports its products to approximately 27 countries. The company was formerly known as Nandan Exim Limited and changed its name to Nandan Denim Limited in November 2013. Nandan Denim Limited was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

NGIL.NS.d: Nakoda Group of Industries Limited, established in Nagpur in 1989, makes and sells natural food ingredients under the Samrat and Nakodas brands. Its range includes staple grains, confectionery, invert sugars, amla products, popcorn, makhanas, fruit purees, preserves, dried fruits, bakery supplies and edible nuts and seeds.

NITIRAJ.NS.d: Nitiraj Engineers Limited manufactures and sells a range of electronic weighing scales and systems, currency counting machines, and electronic fare meters for industrial and domestic consumption.

RANASUG.NS.d: Rana Sugars Limited manufactures and sells sugar, molasses, and bagasse in India. It operates through three segments: Sugar Manufacturing, Ethanol Manufacturing, and Power Generation. The company offers double refined white sulphurless, plantation white, and raw sugar, as well as sugar from sugar beet. It also produces power from bagasse; manufactures various grades of alcohol, such as rectified spirit and potable grade extra neutral alcohol, as well as liquor; and offers sugar beet pulp as cattle feed.

SENORES.NS.d: Senores Pharmaceuticals Limited is an Ahmedabad-based drug company founded in 2017. It develops, makes and sells pharmaceutical products in India, the US, the UK, Canada and other countries, covering many therapy areas such as pain, infection, heart and nerve conditions, plus supplements and generics. It also offers management consulting.

SEYAIND.NS.d: Seya Industries Limited manufactures and sells specialty chemicals in India and internationally. The company's products include pigment intermediates, chloro benzenes, nitro chloro benzenes, and acids. It offers its products for use in computer printing inks, pigments and paints, pharmaceuticals, personal and health care products, agrochemicals, insecticides/pesticides, organic chemical intermediates, rubber chemicals, textile dyes, thermic fluids, etc.

SHARDACROP.NS.d: Sharda Cropchem Limited, a crop protection chemical company, provides various formulations and generic active ingredients worldwide. The company operates through Agrochemicals, and Belts segments. It offers agrochemical products, including insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, veterinary drugs, plant growth regulators, fumigants, regulators, rodenticides, metalaxyl, propiconazole, phenthoate, pendimethalin, and dithianon; and biocides.

SHARDAMOTR.NS.d: Sharda Motor Industries Limited manufactures, assembles, and sells auto components and white goods components to automobiles and electronics original equipment manufacturers in India.

SUNSHIEL.NS.d: Sunshield Chemicals Limited manufactures and markets chemicals. The company's products include dyes and pigments. Sunshield Chemicals Limited is based in India.

SVLL.NS.d: Shree Vasu Logistics Limited is an Indian logistics business whose segments are logistics, warehousing and related services, and retail trade. It provides carrying and forwarding, warehouse rental, packing, transport, distribution and third-party logistics, delivering supply chain solutions with live tracking and last-mile optimization to electronics, FMCG and e-commerce customers.

THACKER.NS.d: Thacker and Company Limited is an Indian company engaged in the business of trading and distribution of various products, including chemicals, textiles, and engineering goods. They serve a diverse range of industries in India. The company is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

TIMKEN.NS.d: Timken India Limited manufactures and distributes tapered roller bearings, components, and accessories for the automotive sector and railway industry in India and internationally.

TVSSCS.NS.d: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited provides integrated supply chain services, mainly in India with global capabilities. Its offerings cover supply chain management from start to finish, running from procurement and sourcing through on-site logistics to warehousing of aftermarket parts and finished goods, together with transportation services.

UFBL.NS.d: United Foodbrands Limited, set up in 2006, with its head office in Bengaluru, runs restaurant businesses including the Barbeque Nation casual dining chain, the Toscano brand of Italian restaurants, and a home delivery offering called Barbeque in a Box. It was initially named Barbeque-Nation Hospitality Limited.

VISHWARAJ.NS.d: Vishwaraj Sugar Industries Limited manufactures and sells sugar and other related products in India. The company operates through five segments: Sugar, Co-Generation, Distillery, Indian Made Liquor, and Vinegar. It also produces distillery products, including ethanol, and rectified and extra-neutral spirits; and bagasse, molasses, brewed vinegar, compost, press-mud, carbon dioxide, etc., as well as blends and bottles Indian made liquor.

YASHO.NS.d: Yasho Industries Limited has been headquartered in Mumbai since it was founded in 1985. It manufactures and supplies specialty and aroma chemicals, including fatty esters and natural essential oils, to personal care, cosmetics, flavor and fragrance, agrochemical, oral care and pharmaceutical customers in the United States, Europe, Asia and the Middle East. It also makes antioxidant chemicals for food.

ZUARIIND.NS.d: Zuari Industries Limited is a diversified Indian group established in 1967 and headquartered in Gurugram. Formerly Zuari Global Limited, it has used its present name since June 2022, and its activities cover services, lifestyle products, infrastructure development, heavy engineering and agriculture, organised into eight segments.
